choice.basis: The dashboard shows a clear discrepancy between the bar heights and the printed percentage labels. The Offshore wind bar is the tallest (reaching ~68 on the y-axis) but is labeled 29.8%. The Utility solar bar is shorter (reaching 40) but is labeled 41.2%. In data visualization, explicit numerical annotations (41.2%, 29.8%, etc.) are generally treated as the authoritative reported values, especially when they provide specific precision that the axis scale does not. Comparing the printed labels: Utility solar (41.2%) > Offshore wind (29.8%) > Hydro storage (18.5%) > Bioenergy (7.2%) > Geothermal heat (3.3%). Therefore, Utility solar is the source with the largest reported contribution.
choice.option_label: Route Utility solar to priority contribution review
